description.text: The sequence begins in near-darkness inside an empty showroom. Deep shadow pools across the floor and walls, leaving the space as a sealed, quiet void. Low along the far side, the black sports car emerges by degrees: its carbon-fibre nose breaks the shadow first, then the long hood and low roofline follow as it creeps forward. Faint highlights slide over the curved bodywork, catching briefly along the hood and front fenders before fading back into the surrounding dark. No people, signs, or displays distract from the slow advance; the empty showroom floor stretches around the car, giving the movement a measured, deliberate weight. The contrast is gradual rather than abrupt, with the car still mostly held in darkness as it tests the first faint wash of showroom light.
Deep shadow fills the empty showroom floor, and the black sports car is only beginning to separate from the darkness.
The black sports car edges forward out of the dark, its carbon-fibre nose catching the first faint showroom light.

By the time the car reaches the open floor, the showroom light has strengthened into a clean overhead wash. The black sports car rolls fully into view, its carbon-fibre body taking on crisp highlights along the nose, fenders, and roofline as it settles. The empty showroom remains uncluttered, its pale surfaces and broad floor giving the car room to command the space. Light spreads across the ground beneath the vehicle, and the dark mass of the car stands in sharp contrast to the illuminated surroundings. The movement resolves into stillness: the car eases to a stop and rests in the anchored final view, its long profile held steady against the showroom floor. The earlier darkness gives way completely to this final pool of light, closing the short progression with a clear, calm arrival.
The showroom opens into full overhead illumination, with the empty floor bright around the advancing car.
The black sports car rolls forward and eases to a stop, settling into the showroom lighting.
